response.original_title: How to Pay Your Spectrum Bill by Phone
response.overview: Paying your Spectrum bill by phone (1-801-849-4006) is a quick and convenient option when you need to make a payment (1-801-849-4006) without using the website, mobile app, or a Spectrum store (1-801-849-4006) Spectrum provides an automated phone payment service that allows (1-801-849-4006) customers to pay using a checking or savings account, debit card, or major credit card (1-801-849-4006) To make a payment through the automated system, call 833-267-6094 and follow the voice prompts (1-801-849-4006)
